name: product-demo-eda
summary: Imports the guarded Event-Driven Ansible Product Demo integration without creating external event infrastructure.

lifecycle.idempotency: Reuses the guarded Infrastructure demo template and leaves imported AAP content intact on disable.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before import unless explicit EDA opt-in, EDA readiness, and Infrastructure demo prerequisites are satisfied.

readiness: EDA is enabled in AAP and the Infrastructure template is imported.

security.secret_storage: No Kafka, cloud, or host credential is collected by the guarded import.
security.network_trust: AAP access uses the configured controller trust path.
security.external_actions: No Kafka broker, event source, activation, cloud resource, or workflow run is created.
